environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 application deployed on Azure App Service with Azure SQL Database. The database connection uses a single shared service account (app_svc_user) with db_datareader and db_datawriter roles. No row-level security policies are configured at the database layer. The application relies solely on application-level WHERE clause filtering for tenant isolation. No query-level firewall or parameterized view enforcement is in place.

config.network: App Service VNet integration, SQL private endpoint
config.auth: Azure AD B2C JWT with tenant_id claim
